overall_goal: Add various seasonings to the shredded chicken and mix them together.

goals.description: Add ground chili to the bowl.
goals.rationale: The person opens the ground chili bottle, retrieves a spoon, and scoops the chili powder into the bowl.

goals.description: Add garlic powder to the bowl.
goals.rationale: The person opens the garlic powder bottle and uses a spoon to scoop and pour it into the bowl.

goals.description: Add ground black pepper to the bowl.
goals.rationale: The person opens the black pepper bottle and scoops the pepper into the bowl.

goals.description: Add salt and mix the seasonings in the bowl.
goals.rationale: The person pours salt into the bowl using a spoon, closes and stores the salt bottle, and then mixes all the added spices together.
